definition.en: How long something is, from one end to the other. A pencil can be {u:9 cm} long.
definition.zh: 一样东西从一端到另一端有多长。一支铅笔可以长 {u:9 cm}。

definition.en: A unit for short lengths. On a school ruler, the part between two marks next to each other is {u:1 cm}.
definition.zh: 量短东西的单位。学校尺子上，两条相邻刻度线中间的一格是 {u:1 cm}。

definition.en: A unit for longer lengths. {u:1 m} = {u:100 cm}; a classroom door is about {u:2 m} tall.
definition.zh: 量长一些的东西的单位。{u:1 m} = {u:100 cm}；教室的门大约 {u:2 m} 高。

definition.en: A unit for long distances. {u:1 km} = {u:1000 m}.
definition.zh: 量路程的单位。{u:1 km} = {u:1000 m}。在新加坡，口语里常说“公里”，1 公里就是 1 千米。

definition.en: How heavy something is. This pineapple has a mass of {u:1 kg}.
definition.zh: 一样东西有多重。这个黄梨的质量是 {u:1 kg}。日常也说“重量”；本课用“质量”，和英文的 mass 对应。

definition.en: A unit for the mass of light things. A paper clip is about {u:1 g}.
definition.zh: 量轻东西的质量单位。一个回形针大约 {u:1 g}。

definition.en: A unit for the mass of heavier things. {u:1 kg} = {u:1000 g}.
definition.zh: 量重一些的东西的质量单位。{u:1 kg} = {u:1000 g}。在新加坡，口语里常说“公斤”，1 公斤就是 1 千克。

definition.en: How much liquid there is, or how much a container holds. To compare, pour into the same kind of container.
definition.zh: 有多少液体，或者一个容器装得下多少液体。要比，就倒进一样的容器里比。英文里 MOE 写 volume；以后学正方体、长方体时，同一个量叫“体积”。

definition.en: A unit of volume, written ℓ. {u:1 l} = {u:1000 ml}.
definition.zh: 容量的单位，写作 ℓ。{u:1 l} = {u:1000 ml}。

definition.en: A unit for small amounts of liquid. A beaker filled to {u:1000 ml} holds {u:1 l}.
definition.zh: 量少量液体的单位。量杯装到 {u:1000 ml}，就是 {u:1 l}。

definition.en: The lines and numbers on a ruler, a weighing scale or a measuring cup that you read a measurement from. Long marks have numbers; short marks often do not.
definition.zh: 尺子、秤、量杯上一条条的线和数，用来读出量。长刻度标数，短刻度常常不标。

definition.en: The space between two marks next to each other. What it stands for = the difference between two numbered marks ÷ the number of parts between them.
definition.zh: 两条相邻刻度线之间的一段。每一小格表示多少 = 两个相邻标数之差 ÷ 它们中间的格数。

definition.en: A tool for comparing masses: the heavier side goes down, and when the two sides are level they have the same mass.
definition.zh: 比轻重的器具：重的一边往下沉，两边一样高就是一样重。

definition.en: A cup or jug with marks on its side for measuring liquid. Read it from the side, with your eyes level with the water.
definition.zh: 侧面带刻度、用来量液体的杯子或壶。要从侧面读，眼睛和水面一样高。实验室里直筒的那种叫“烧杯”。

definition.en: A measurement written with two units together, such as {u:2 m 35 cm} or {u:3 kg 40 g}.
definition.zh: 用两个单位一起写的量，比如 {u:2 m 35 cm}、{u:3 kg 40 g}。也叫“复名数”。

definition.en: A sensible guess of about how much, made before you measure, to check your reading. A door is about {u:2 m} tall.
definition.zh: 量之前先猜一个大约的数，用来检查读得对不对。门大约 {u:2 m} 高。
